svg.title: Plasma BDNF by subgroup (pg/mL)
svg.desc: Mean plasma BDNF, start / 1 month / 5 months. 1a semax early: 7.8, 22.6, 19.4. 1b no semax early: 8.6, 17.9, 12.2. 2a semax late: 8.1, 23.6, 20.8. 2b no semax late: 7.9, 12.3, 10.7.
